question: How is the goddess Tripurā characterized as the source and abode of good fortune?
premises: The goddess is addressed as Tripurā.
She is described as the abode of the birth of good fortune.
This is to be understood properly.
inference: Tripurā is properly recognized as the dwelling place from which good fortune arises.
uncertainties: This verse continues the syntactic unit begun in verse 1422.
plain_english: O Tripurā, properly understood as the abode where good fortune is born...
